name: Hive AutoLinker
author: opportunityhive

sections.description:
Hive AutoLinker is a powerful WordPress plugin that automatically creates internal links throughout your website based on keywords you define. It helps improve your site’s SEO, user experience, and content discoverability by intelligently linking related content together.

Core Features

  • Manual Keyword Management – Add keywords and specify which URLs they should link to
  • Intelligent Link Placement – Automatically replaces keywords in your content with proper internal links
  • Link Type Control – Choose between follow and nofollow link attributes
  • Internal Link Reporting – View comprehensive reports of your site’s internal linking structure
  • Export Functionality – Export your keyword data to CSV for backup or analysis
  • Smart Content Processing – Uses DOM parsing to avoid linking within existing links or HTML attributes
  • Customizable Settings – Control maximum replacements per keyword and case sensitivity

How It Works

  1. Define Keywords: Add keywords or phrases you want to automatically link
  2. Set Target URLs: Specify which internal pages each keyword should link to
  3. Automatic Processing: The plugin automatically adds links when content is displayed
  4. Monitor Results: Use the built-in reports to track your internal linking structure

Benefits for SEO

  • Improved Page Authority Distribution – Spread link equity throughout your site
  • Better Content Discoverability – Help search engines find and index your content
  • Enhanced User Experience – Keep visitors engaged with relevant internal links
  • Reduced Bounce Rate – Guide users to related content automatically

Technical Features

  • Performance Optimized – Uses caching to minimize database queries
  • Safe HTML Processing – Won’t interfere with existing links or break your HTML
  • Bulk Operations – Efficiently processes large amounts of content
  • Admin Interface – Clean, intuitive dashboard for managing all settings

Premium Features

Upgrade to Hive AutoLinker Premium for advanced features including:

  • Google Search Console Integration – Import keyword data directly from GSC
  • Auto-Suggestions – AI-powered suggestions for internal linking opportunities
  • Link Agreements Management – Track commercial links with review dates
  • Advanced Analytics – Detailed reports on link performance
  • Priority Support – Get help when you need it

Visit HiveAutoLinker.com to learn more about premium features.

Privacy and Data

This plugin does not collect or store any personal data from your website visitors. All keyword and linking data is stored locally in your WordPress database.

The premium version includes optional Google Search Console integration, which requires authentication with Google’s services and follows their privacy policies.

Support

For support questions, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit our support forum or contact us through HiveAutoLinker.com.

Development

This plugin is actively developed and maintained. We welcome feedback and suggestions for new features. Visit our website to stay updated on new releases and features.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Hive AutoLinker”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin after installation

Getting Started

  1. After activation, go to Hive AutoLinker in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Click Add New Keyword to create your first automatic link
  3. Enter a keyword or phrase and the URL it should link to
  4. Save your settings and the plugin will automatically start creating links
sections.faq:
Does this plugin slow down my website?

No, Hive AutoLinker is designed for performance. It uses caching mechanisms and efficient processing to minimize impact on your site’s loading speed.

Will it interfere with my existing links?

No, the plugin uses intelligent DOM parsing to avoid creating links within existing links or HTML attributes. Your existing links remain untouched.

Can I control how many times a keyword is linked per post?

Yes, you can set the maximum number of replacements per keyword in the settings. The default is 1 replacement per post to avoid over-optimization.

Does it work with page builders like Elementor or Gutenberg?

Yes, the plugin works with any content that goes through WordPress’s content filters, including page builders and the block editor.

Can I exclude certain pages from automatic linking?

The plugin processes content through WordPress’s standard content filters. You can control linking behavior through the settings and keyword management.

Will this help my SEO?

Yes, proper internal linking is a well-established SEO best practice. It helps search engines understand your site structure and distributes page authority throughout your site.

Can I see what links the plugin has created?

Yes, the Internal Link Report shows you a comprehensive view of all links on your site, including those created by the plugin.

Is there a way to backup my keyword data?

Yes, you can export all your keywords to a CSV file for backup or analysis purposes.

Does it create nofollow links?

You can choose whether each keyword creates follow or nofollow links. Most internal links should be follow links for SEO benefits.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Links created by the plugin will stop being added to new content, but existing links in your content will remain until you manually remove them.
